forEmployers.metaDescription: Post remote jobs for free and reach people whose skills, salary expectations and working hours match.

company.title: Company
company.text: Create your company and verify it with a corporate email or a DNS record.

job.title: Job
job.text: Describe the job: skills, salary range, format, required overlap of working hours.

match.title: Matching
match.text: We show it to matching candidates and tell them why it fits.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.text: Review applications and mark the ones you like — that is when their contacts open.

why.match: Matching by skills and time zone, not keywords.
why.salary: Candidates see your range with currency and taxes taken into account — fewer off-target applications.
why.both: Web3 and regular remote work in one place, in English and Russian.
why.trust: A verified badge builds trust and gets more replies.

unverified.title: Unverified
unverified.text: Jobs are moderated, up to 5 posts per day.

verified.title: Verified
verified.text: Corporate email or DNS plus business details. Up to 50 posts per day and a badge.

trusted.title: Trusted
trusted.text: Granted automatically after steady activity without complaints.

limit.q: How many jobs can I post?

review.q: Why is my job under review?
review.a: The company is not verified yet or the post looks risky. Review usually takes up to a day.

contacts.q: When do I see a candidate's contacts?
contacts.a: After you mark the application as interesting: it moves to the shortlist and the contacts open.

salary.q: Can I leave the salary out?
salary.a: Yes, but such jobs rank lower in candidates' matches.

forEmployers.finalText: Post your first job — it takes 5 minutes.
